title.zh: 英伟达刚拿下美国开源第一，Meta就以39分反超，Agent跑分却落后中国模型
title.en: 英伟达刚拿下美国开源第一，Meta就以39分反超，Agent跑分却落后中国模型

current_state.zh: Meta's newly released open-weights model Muse Spark Open scored 39 on the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, displacing Nvidia's Nemotron 3.5 Super VL as the top US open model but trailing Chinese models like Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro (46) and Zhipu GLM-5.3 (45), with notably weak agent-test performance offset by best-in-class knowledge accuracy and lower token costs.
